Release Notes

Published by : Admin
Published on : 2020-09-08 07:39:53

Eternity v1.0 — Archive Edition (2026)

Eternity Esports is no longer running scrims. The website has been restored as a read-only archive so this project stays online, and its code was rebuilt to modern security standards while keeping the original 2020 design.

  1. Archive mode: the site is read-only, and registrations, scrims and messages are closed. Visitors can still explore the Player and Administrator dashboards through demo access on the Login page.
  2. Rebuilt on PHP 8 with prepared statements for every database query (protection against SQL injection)
  3. Passwords are hashed with bcrypt, and signing in uses a secure session cookie only. Credentials are never stored in cookies.
  4. Roles are verified on the server for every page and action. Administrator access can no longer be selected from the login form.
  5. All user content is escaped (protection against XSS), and every page is served with a strict Content Security Policy
  6. CSRF protection on every form. Delete actions require a confirmed POST request.
  7. Uploaded photos are verified as real images, renamed, re-encoded and stored privately
  8. Messages are encrypted with authenticated AES-256-GCM. Login, registration and feedback are rate-limited on the server.
  9. Updated to Bootstrap 4.6.2 / 3.4.1, jQuery 3.7.1 and Font Awesome 4.7, all served locally

Eternity v0.11

  1. Added 3+ layers of security to Eternity Website :
    • Added SSL Certificates to Secure Clients' Information when the data travelling from Clients' Computer to WebServer
    • Added security features in Messages, Login, Register, etc to prevent from Bots and Spam
    • Changed some logics in Validation Login and Register Form
    • Disabled Error Messages to prevent from vulnerabilities, data breaches, etc.
  2. Added MultiLanguage Features which is Indonesia (ID)
  3. Added Error Pages :
    • 403 Forbidden
    • 404 Not Found
    • 405 Method Not Allowed
    • 408 Request Time Out
    • 500 Internal Server Error
    • 502 Bad Gateway
    • 503 Service Currently Unavailable
    • 504 Gateway Timeout
  4. Fixed Minor Bugs on Message Validation, Login Validation, and Register Validation
  5. Changed Style of :
    • Message Form
    • Login Form
    • Register Form
  6. Fixed User Interface (UI) in Login and Register Form
  7. Limitation of requests in Message, Login, and Register Form are Removed and changed with reCAPTCHA
